dataset_title: Background data for: Climate impact and land use of processing grass-clover biomass cultivated under different nitrogen fertilization rates in green biorefinery

observations.cp_and_clover_observation_column_units: Not defined in the source README; values retained without unit assignment or conversion.
observations.replicate_treatment: Source README states chemical-analysis samples were pooled and DM yields averaged across three replicates by treatment, cut, location and year.

experimental_context.crop: Cultivated grass-clover ley: timothy, meadow fescue, red clover
experimental_context.geography: Eight Norwegian sites in Southern and Central Norway
experimental_context.cuts: Three cuts per season in the released dataset
experimental_context.status: Measured field-trial summaries in a CC0 secondary data publication; not raw replicate data.

runtime_policy: Do not map to roadside-grass defaults, process parameters, route, UI overrides or Pareto calculations.
applicability_limit: Cultivated timothy/meadow-fescue/red-clover field experiments in Norway, not roadside grass or GreenHub supply. The 192 rows are treatment summaries; measurements were pooled or averaged across three replicates, not replicate-level raw data. Source README defines yield columns as g/m2 and N_rate codes as 0/8/16/24 = 0/80/160/240 kg N/ha, but does not define units for CP_* or clover_* columns; preserve those source values without conversion. Dot is the missing-data code. No runtime/default use.

fair.findable: Dataset DOI, related article DOI, local source ID and checksummed asset paths are recorded.
fair.accessible: Public DataverseNO API and CC0 license.
fair.interoperable: UTF-8 semicolon CSVs; source Exp_no joins experiment records to a separate location crosswalk.
fair.reusable: Raw source files are preserved byte-for-byte; source README, file checksums, mapping limits and missingness codes are recorded.
